Incident Bot: [ALERT] 2024-06-01 09:42Z — elevated latency on /v1/generate p95 > 1.5s in us-west-2. paging @alex. Incident ID: INC-20240601-02
Alex Chen: acknowledged. looking at traces and infra dashboard now.
Alex Chen: p95 spike appears correlated with increased KV cache miss rate and higher GPU memory allocs on pool-gpu-b. can someone check session sizes?
Simon Park: joining. tailing runtime logs and scraping kv metrics. initial hunch: long-lived streaming sessions have grown in memory usage.
Simon Park: diag commands: 
```
redwood-cli metrics query --metric=kv_session_size --region=us-west-2 --window=5m
kubectl -n redwood logs deploy/serve-runtime -c runtime | grep OOM
```
Simon Park: confirmed some OOM warnings around 09:40Z on serve-runtime pods.
Marta Singh: i'm seeing a spike in active sessions >1k tokens from user-agent campaign traffic (payments-pro). could be a customer campaign hitting streaming API with large contexts.
Alex Chen: mitigation plan — enumerate options: 1) enable fallback routing to low-memory variant (tiny-alpha) for latency-sensitive route; 2) run targeted eviction for session KV; 3) spin up an extra GPU node; 4) enable rate limit for streaming endpoints temporarily. propose doing 1 then 2 in parallel.
Incident Bot: routing override created by Alex Chen — /v1/generate (latency_sensitive) -> tiny-alpha, TTL=25m
Jamal Brooks: putting cost note: fallback will slightly change token billing but keeps SLOs. fine to proceed.
Eva Torres: flagging support — payments-pro is on a managed plan, looping in account manager after we have impact numbers.
Simon Park: executed eviction: `redwood-cli cache evict --policy=idle --age=10m --target=streaming_sessions` — freed ~4.8GB & 90k entries. KV hit ratio improving.
Marta Singh: metrics: p95 improved from ~1.6s to ~480ms within 70s of routing override + eviction.
Alex Chen: starting node add in case memory leaks persist. command: `gcloud compute instances create gpu-pool-27 --zone=us-west2-b ...`
Incident Bot: Node gpu-pool-27 joined pool-gpu-b at 09:51Z
Simon Park: after node join, memory pressure back to baseline. rolling back routing override in 12m to verify stability. will ramp traffic with a canary.
Alex Chen: please use a phased canary: 5% -> 25% -> 60% over 10m. post metrics at each step.
Marta Singh: noted. also adding runbook entry recommendation: if cache-evict removes >75k entries, escalate to eng-sre and open a GC ticket.
Simon Park: quick customer impact snapshot: payments-pro observed request queueing up to 28s during 09:39-09:51Z window; approx 1.1k requests affected, error rate +1.1% above baseline.
Eva Torres: drafting customer note for payments-pro: timeframe 09:39-09:51 UTC, degraded latency and transient queueing, mitigation steps and planned remediation. will attach postmortem link.
Alex Chen: action items and owners — postmortem doc (owner: Simon Park), customer comms (owner: Eva Torres), runbook & playbook updates (owner: Alex Chen), session GC and quota work (owner: Marta Singh), billing/cost apportionment (owner: Jamal Brooks).
Simon Park: creating postmortem now: /docs/incidents/INC-20240601-02.md — will include timeline, commands, logs, RCA and remediation plan.
Alex Chen: scheduling a 45m postmortem review for 2024-06-02 14:00Z. attendees: eng-oncall, eng-runtime, eng-sre, support, product. triggering calendar invite.
Incident Bot: Calendar invite created: Postmortem INC-20240601-02 — 2024-06-02 14:00Z
Marta Singh: runbook quick patches to apply immediately: add section under "P0 > KV cache pressure":
- command for eviction: `redwood-cli cache evict --policy=idle --age=10m --target=streaming_sessions`
- post-eviction check: `redwood-cli metrics query --metric=kv_hit_rate --window=2m`
- escalation criteria: eviction removes >75k entries OR active sessions >1k tokens for >5m -> escalate to eng-sre + open ticket OPS-xxxx
Alex Chen: also update on-call handoff guidance: if handoff occurs during incident, the outgoing oncall must add a brief to thread with current mitigations, pending actions with owners, and whether customer comms have been notified. create a `handoff-template.txt` and add to playbook.
Jamal Brooks: created FIN ticket FIN-4210 to record extra infra cost: estimate 1 extra node for ~12m -> ~$1.20; will finalize after postmortem.
Eva Torres: customer draft: 
"We experienced elevated latencies in US-West on 2024-06-01 between 09:39-09:51 UTC affecting a subset of requests. We mitigated by routing to fallback variants and scaling capacity. We're investigating and will follow up with a full postmortem and credits for impacted usage."
Alex Chen: link the postmortem in the draft and cc account manager.
Simon Park: postmortem draft pushed, requesting reviews: @marta @alex @eva @jamal. includes timeline snippet: 
```
09:39Z - p95 starts rising
09:42Z - Incident bot pages oncall
09:43Z - routing override enabled to tiny-alpha
09:44Z - cache eviction executed
09:51Z - node gpu-pool-27 joins pool-gpu-b
09:55Z - metrics stable, rollback routing override confirmed
```
Marta Singh: follow-ups: add unit tests for session GC, add alert for active sessions >1k tokens, and enforce per-session token quota (proposal: 2M token reject threshold). due date for GC & quotas: 2024-06-25 (owner: Marta Singh).
Alex Chen: updating playbook PR: infra/playbooks oncall/kv-pressure-fix. include exact commands, escalation path, and handoff template. PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/-/merge_requests/590
Eva Torres: after postmortem meeting i'll send customer comms and close the loop. will include proposed credit amount once FIN confirms.
Simon Park: marking incident INC-20240601-02 as RESOLVED in channel. handing long-term fixes to Marta.
Marta Singh: taking ownership of GC/quotas. will post weekly status updates to the runbook follow-up ticket. closing thread.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-20240601-02 status: RESOLVED at 2024-06-01 10:48Z
